# Angler News South Africa — independent pitch concept
This is an unaffiliated website design preview, not the official ANSA site.
Official source: https://anglernews.co.za/
Public podcast: https://www.ecr.co.za/podcasts/ansa/
This evaluation prototype retrieves three-day modelled sea-level/tide and pressure forecasts from Open-Meteo for Durban, Richards Bay, East London and Cape Town. It shows SAST dates, MSL datum, attribution and limitations. Predictions are not observed harbour tides or navigation guidance.
Archive catch measurements are reported by the linked original ECR/ANSA articles, not independently certified records. Pressure guidance is educational and promises no catch outcome.
